# Bounded provenance evidence

`public-law.json` retains one ZIP acquisition receipt row and the member byte
facts checked offline against its retained blob. `observations.json` contains
seven URL/byte observations, each with the source path, digest and selector.
These are evidence inputs, maintained independently of the capture converter.
The original campaign receipts remain outside the repository.

The CFR and committee-report records retain date-only acquisition precision;
a date is not converted to an invented midnight. The bill observation is the
original parser-probe receipt named by its fixture README. The Senate URL
names the full publisher PDF, never the derived one-page fixture.
